# Putnam Lead Group

> Veteran-owned business in Putnam County, Florida that helps local service businesses (lawn care, HVAC, plumbing, roofing, metal and auto shops and other trades) show up on Google and in AI search, look trustworthy, and earn real reviews. Founder: Kyle Simmons, Marine Corps veteran and former law enforcement officer who lives in Putnam County.

- Area served: Palatka, East Palatka, Interlachen, Crescent City, Welaka, San Mateo, Pomona Park, Satsuma, Hollister, Bostwick, Florahome, Georgetown, Putnam Hall, Melrose and the rest of Putnam County, FL.
- Phone: (386) 227-7496. Email: hello@putnamleads.com. Website: https://putnamleads.com/
- Prices: free Google check; $299 one-time Google Business Profile cleanup; $175 a month "Keep It Fresh" plan (weekly Google posts, job photos added, every review answered, monthly plain-English report), month to month with 30 days' notice to stop.
- Policies: no passwords needed (manager access only); real reviews only, never written, bought or gated; no ranking guarantees.

- [Home](https://putnamleads.com/): services, pricing, towns served, FAQ.

- [AI search test](https://putnamleads.com/ai-search/): a free 2-minute test to see if ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Google's AI answers mention a local business, and 7 fixes.
